model: 16" Bicycle Cargo Trailer with Removable Cover
description:
Large Capacity & Safety Design: Featuring a lightweight yet sturdy metal frame, this bicycle trailer offers ample storage space. It is equipped with 2 red and 4 yellow reflectors to enhance visibility during nighttime rides, ensuring your safety.

Versatile Design: Ideal for daily commuting or long-distance travel, this trailer is a versatile choice. It can be used for shopping, transporting goods, and other errands. You can even use it to take your pets along for a ride.

Detachable Cover: The trailer comes with a removable cover made of 600 x 600D Oxford fabric with a PVC waterproof coating. This allows you to use the trailer outdoors and protect the items stored inside the cargo area.

Easy Storage: The bicycle trailer is designed for easy disassembly. The wheels and cargo area can be quickly detached to minimize space occupancy. It includes a user-friendly hitch that securely attaches to your rear wheel, enabling quick installation and removal.

Smooth Ride: Equipped with durable wheels and a stable suspension system, this trailer ensures a smooth and comfortable ride. It is built to withstand various terrains, making it suitable for different cycling adventures.

1. Spacious storage space: Whether you are going shopping, transporting items, or carrying picnic gear, our bike trailer rack offers spacious storage space. You can easily put what you need into the trailer rack and secure it securely, enjoying convenient storage and portability.
